checkpoints.completion_status: UNKNOWN: whole-drone containment, landing and disarming require runtime observations; this module issues no commands.

grid_validation: Every simplified segment and every finite portal crossing checked against the same selected-height grid, with no diagonal corner cutting.

header.provenance: Published OBJ triangle geometry only; no run or recording data.
header.notice: Map-derived prior from the published layout (rule 6.4), not fixed flight waypoints or timings. Runtime must localise and react to live perception (generality, rule 9.5). Coordinates are preliminary and may change.
header.height_band_definition: Allowed sampled centre heights, NOT a full-height vehicle envelope. Main occupancy is one horizontal slice, not a union across the band.
header.artifact: Map-derived corridor seed; not executable flight waypoints or timings.

selection_method: Lowest computed A* clearance-weighted search cost among resolved alternatives; no score, bonus, timing or prerecorded run data.
runtime_contract: Re-extract when the published model changes. Runtime localises against live perception, checks vehicle/body clearance, replans around observed differences, and determines whole-drone crossing/landing state.
unknowns: Official dashed checkpoint-line placement is not encoded in the mesh; wall-edge connectors and cap planes are geometric priors.
Vehicle dimensions, localisation error, operational clearance, landing/disarm state and between-height transitions are not established.
